# comdynamite

Methods that link traits, phylogenies, biogeography and metacommunities
in R, to analyse data and to simulate it.

## What do you want to do?

**Analyse data**

| Question | Functions | Article |
|----|----|----|
| Which clades respond to the environment or to biogeographic events? | [`node_contrasts()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/node_contrasts.md), [`biogeography_matrix()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/biogeography_matrix.md), [`node_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/node_test.md) | [Analysing clades](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/analysing-clades.html) |
| Does phylogenetic composition follow the environment across the whole tree? | [`pcc_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcc_test.md), [`pcps_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcps_test.md), [`phylo_beta_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_beta_test.md) | [Testing the whole tree](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/whole-tree.html) |
| Which phylogenetic axis relates to a predictor? | [`phylo_vector()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_vector.md) | [Analysing clades](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/analysing-clades.html) |
| How much of trait or phylogenetic variation is due to environment and space? | [`trait_partition()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_partition.md), [`plot_trait_partition()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_trait_partition.md) | [Analysing clades](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/analysing-clades.html) |
| My sites are neighbours: which null model? | [`torus_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/torus_permutations.md), [`rigid_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/rigid_permutations.md), [`patch_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/patch_permutations.md) | [Analysing clades](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/analysing-clades.html) |
| How do I format my own data? |  | [Preparing your data](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/preparing-data.html) |

**Simulate data**

| Question | Functions | Article |
|----|----|----|
| Dynamics with growth, competition and dispersal, as in Thompson et al. (2020) | [`simulate_metacommunity()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_metacommunity.md) | [Get started](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/comdynamite.html) |
| Static communities along gradients | [`simulate_static()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_static.md), [`simulate_logistic()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_logistic.md) | [Testing the whole tree](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/whole-tree.html) |
| Assembly by rules, without dynamics, as in Kraft et al. (2007) | [`assemble_community()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/assemble_community.md) | [Watching assembly](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/watching-assembly.html) |
| Traits with phylogenetic signal or under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck regimes | [`species_traits()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/species_traits.md), [`trait_ou()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_ou.md) | [Get started](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/comdynamite.html) |
| Does a method work? Type I error and power by simulation | all of the above | [Evaluating methods](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/articles/evaluating-methods.html) |

In R,
[`?comdynamite`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/comdynamite-package.md)
gives the same map.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("comdynamite", repos = c("https://diogoprov.r-universe.dev",
                                          "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
# or
remotes::install_github("diogoprov/comdynamite")
```

## Large analyses

The permutations of
[`pcc_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcc_test.md),
[`pcps_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcps_test.md),
[`phylo_beta_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_beta_test.md)
and
[`trait_partition()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_partition.md)
run in parallel when you choose a plan with the future package, and
results can be reproduced with
[`set.seed()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Random.html) for any number of
workers.
[`node_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/node_test.md)
has its own `cores` argument: it took about 4 minutes with 600 species,
100 sites and 999 permutations on one core.

``` r

future::plan(future::multisession, workers = 4)
```

Inputs can be tibbles of numeric columns, and
[`as.data.frame()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/as.data.frame.html) or
[`tibble::as_tibble()`](https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/as_tibble.html)
turn results into tables.

## Example

``` r

library(comdynamite)
set.seed(1)
tr <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(40)
sim <- simulate_metacommunity(
  landscape  = landscape_implicit(50),
  traits     = species_traits(tr, lambda = 1),
  alpha      = competition_matrix(tr, type = "phylo"),
  dispersal  = 0.01,
  n_steps    = 1000
)
sim$abundance  # sites x species
```

The [website](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/) has the articles and
the function reference. To read the vignettes in R, install with
`build_vignettes = TRUE`.

## Related packages

- **[mcomsimr](https://github.com/plthompson/mcomsimr)**, by Patrick
  Thompson, is the original R implementation of the model of Thompson et
  al. (2020). comdynamite was written independently from the published
  equations. It differs in its conventions (`sigma` is the standard
  deviation of the Gaussian response, so it equals `sqrt(2)` times the
  niche breadth of Thompson et al.; `alpha[j, k]` is the effect of
  species k on species j) and adds phylogenetic traits and competition,
  grid landscapes on a torus with their restricted permutations, and
  abundances recorded over time.

- **[gen3sis](https://github.com/project-gen3sis/R-package)** (Hagen et
  al.

  2021. is a general engine for eco-evolutionary simulations on
        landscapes that change over geological time. Speciation,
        extinction, dispersal and trait evolution are simulated, so the
        **phylogeny is an outcome** of the simulation, and the
        ecological rules are functions that the user writes. In
        comdynamite the **phylogeny is an input**: the tree is fixed,
        traits are placed on it with a chosen phylogenetic signal, and a
        fixed population model runs over ecological time (no
        speciation). This is what simulation studies of methods need,
        because tree shape and phylogenetic signal can be set
        independently and replicates can be paired by tree across
        scenarios. The two can be combined: a phylogeny produced by
        gen3sis can be used as the regional pool of a comdynamite
        simulation.

- **[treeshapesim](https://github.com/diogoprov/treeshapesim)**
  simulates trees with separately controlled imbalance and branching
  times, to use as regional pools in comdynamite. Tree shape can then be
  a factor in the design of a simulation study:

  ``` r

  tr <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(40, beta = -1, c = -0.5)
  sim <- simulate_metacommunity(landscape_implicit(20), species_traits(tr, lambda = 1),
                                competition_matrix(tr, type = "phylo"),
                                dispersal = 0.01, n_steps = 1000)
  ```

## Citation

Provete, D. B. (2026). comdynamite: Linking traits, phylogenies and
biogeography in metacommunities. R package.
<https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23993533>

This DOI always points to the latest version; each release also has its
own DOI on Zenodo. In R, `citation("comdynamite")` gives the entry with
the installed version.

## References

Thompson, P. L., Guzman, L. M., De Meester, L., Horváth, Z., Ptacnik,
R., Vanschoenwinkel, B., Viana, D. S., & Chase, J. M. (2020). A
process-based metacommunity framework linking local and regional scale
community ecology. *Ecology Letters*, 23, 1314–1329.
<https://doi.org/10.1111/ele.13568>

Hagen, O., Flück, B., Fopp, F., Cabral, J. S., Hartig, F., Pontarp, M.,
Rangel, T. F., & Pellissier, L. (2021). gen3sis: A general engine for
eco-evolutionary simulations of the processes that shape Earth’s
biodiversity. *PLoS Biology*, 19, e3001340.
<https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.3001340>

Colwell, R. K., & Winkler, D. W. (1984). A null model for null models in
biogeography. In D. R. Strong, D. Simberloff, L. G. Abele, & A. B.
Thistle (Eds.), *Ecological Communities: Conceptual Issues and the
Evidence* (pp. 344–359). Princeton University Press.
<https://doi.org/10.1515/9781400857081.344>

Kraft, N. J. B., Cornwell, W. K., Webb, C. O., & Ackerly, D. D. (2007).
Trait evolution, community assembly, and the phylogenetic structure of
ecological communities. *The American Naturalist*, 170, 271–283.
<https://doi.org/10.1086/519400>

# Package index

## Data

Community, tree, traits, environment and coordinates in one object.

- [`mc_data()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  [`as_mc_data()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  [`print(`*`<mc_data>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  [`` `[`( ``*`<mc_data>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mc_data>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  [`as.data.frame(`*`<mc_data>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_data.md)
  : Metacommunity data in one object

## Simulate metacommunities

The process-based model, from landscape and traits to abundances.

- [`simulate_metacommunity()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_metacommunity.md)
  : Simulate a metacommunity
- [`simulate_static()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_static.md)
  : Simulate a static metacommunity
- [`simulate_logistic()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_logistic.md)
  : Simulate presences and absences from logistic responses
- [`logistic_gradients()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/logistic_gradients.md)
  : Gradients of the seven scenarios of Peres-Neto et al. (2012)
- [`mc_dynamics()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/mc_dynamics.md)
  : Metacommunity dynamics from growth rates
- [`growth_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/growth_rates.md)
  : Growth rates of each species at each site

## Landscapes

Spatially implicit and grid landscapes, dispersal and environment.

- [`landscape_implicit()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/landscape_implicit.md)
  : Spatially implicit landscape
- [`landscape_grid()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/landscape_grid.md)
  : Spatially explicit landscape on a square grid
- [`dispersal_kernel()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/dispersal_kernel.md)
  : Exponential dispersal kernel
- [`env_over_time()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/env_over_time.md)
  : Environment that changes over time

## Species traits

Traits with phylogenetic signal and evolutionary regimes.

- [`species_traits()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/species_traits.md)
  : Species traits, with or without phylogenetic signal
- [`trait_bm()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_bm.md)
  : Trait evolution by Brownian motion with Pagel's lambda
- [`trait_ou()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_ou.md)
  : Traits evolving by an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process with one or several
  optima
- [`rate_matrix()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/rate_matrix.md)
  [`print(`*`<rate_matrix>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/rate_matrix.md)
  : Evolutionary rate matrices with restricted structures
- [`plot(`*`<rate_matrix>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.rate_matrix.md)
  : Plot evolutionary rate matrices as ellipses
- [`plot_traits()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_traits.md)
  : Plot traits on the tree: phylomorphospace or traitgram
- [`trait_mk()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_mk.md)
  : A discrete trait evolving along a tree, with its whole history
- [`trait_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_rates.md)
  : A continuous trait whose rate of evolution varies among branches
- [`history_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/history_rates.md)
  : Rates of trait evolution from a history along the tree
- [`partner_turnover()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/partner_turnover.md)
  : Turnover of interaction partners in a simulated metacommunity
- [`turnover_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/turnover_rates.md)
  : Rates of trait evolution from the turnover of partners in a
  metacommunity
- [`food_web_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/food_web_rates.md)
  : Rates of trait evolution from the trophic level of each lineage in a
  food web
- [`plot_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_rates.md)
  : Plot rates that vary among branches
- [`tip_history_metrics()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/tip_history_metrics.md)
  : Tip-based metrics of a known trait history
- [`as_herodotools()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/as_herodotools.md)
  : Simulations as input for Herodotools, with the known history
- [`region_pool()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/region_pool.md)
  : Sites where each species can occur, from its region
- [`arrival_ages()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/arrival_ages.md)
  : True ages at which lineages arrived in each region
- [`paint_regimes()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/paint_regimes.md)
  : Assign selective regimes to clades

## Coevolution in food webs

Abundances and mean traits of a resource, a consumer and a predator.

- [`food_web_dynamics()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/food_web_dynamics.md)
  : Coevolution of a resource, a consumer and a predator
- [`food_web_params()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/food_web_params.md)
  : Parameters of the three-trophic-level eco-evolutionary model
- [`plot(`*`<food_web>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.food_web.md)
  : Plot the dynamics of a food web
- [`animate_food_web()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/animate_food_web.md)
  : Animate the dynamics of a food web

## Competition

Interspecific competition, optionally structured by relatedness.

- [`competition_matrix()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/competition_matrix.md)
  : Competition matrix

## Clades and biogeography

Which clades respond to the environment or to biogeographic events?

- [`node_contrasts()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/node_contrasts.md)
  : Node contrasts of a phylogeny
- [`biogeography_matrix()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/biogeography_matrix.md)
  : Matrix of biogeographic events
- [`node_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/node_test.md)
  : Test clades against the environment, node by node
- [`plot_node_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_node_test.md)
  : Plot the results of a node test on the phylogeny
- [`plot_node_heatmap()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_node_heatmap.md)
  : Plot the semipartial correlations of a node test

## The whole tree

Does phylogenetic composition follow the environment?

- [`pcc_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcc_test.md)
  : Test phylogenetic community composition against the environment
- [`pcps_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pcps_test.md)
  : Principal coordinates of phylogenetic structure
- [`plot(`*`<mc_pcps>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.mc_pcps.md)
  : Plot the principal coordinates of phylogenetic structure
- [`phylo_eigenvectors()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_eigenvectors.md)
  : Phylogenetic eigenvectors
- [`phylo_beta_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_beta_test.md)
  : Test phylogenetic beta diversity against the environment
- [`phylo_beta()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_beta.md)
  : Phylogenetic beta diversity between communities
- [`plot_phylo_beta()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_phylo_beta.md)
  : Community matrix ordered by phylogenetic beta diversity

## Environment and space

Phylogenetic vectors and the partition of trait variation.

- [`phylo_vector()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/phylo_vector.md)
  : Represent a phylogeny by one vector related to a predictor
- [`trait_partition()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_partition.md)
  : Partition trait or phylogenetic variation between environment and
  space
- [`plot_trait_partition()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_trait_partition.md)
  : Plot the fractions of a trait partition

## Restricted null models

Permutations for sites that are neighbours.

- [`torus_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/torus_permutations.md)
  : Site permutations that keep the structure of a torus
- [`rigid_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/rigid_permutations.md)
  : Permutations that move biogeographic events as rigid bodies
- [`patch_permutations()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/patch_permutations.md)
  : Permutations that move the patches of biogeographic events

## Simulation studies

Grids of scenarios, summaries and checks.

- [`run_scenarios()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/run_scenarios.md)
  : Run a grid of simulation scenarios
- [`summary_stats()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/summary_stats.md)
  : Summary statistics of a metacommunity
- [`equilibrium_check()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/equilibrium_check.md)
  : Check whether a simulation has settled
- [`as.data.frame(`*`<mc_sim>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/as.data.frame.mc_sim.md)
  : Simulation results as a long table

## Trait variation among individuals

Individuals sampled from simulations, T-statistics, trait-gradient
analysis, community trait indices and decompositions of trait variation.

- [`sample_individuals()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/sample_individuals.md)
  : Individuals from a simulated metacommunity
- [`tstats()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/tstats.md) :
  T-statistics of intraspecific trait variation
- [`tstats_summary()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/tstats_summary.md)
  : Summary of the null-model tests of T-statistics
- [`population_shifts()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/population_shifts.md)
  : Local adaptation and character displacement from population means
- [`plot(`*`<population_shifts>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.population_shifts.md)
  : Plot the profile of a fit of population shifts
- [`trait_gradient()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_gradient.md)
  : Trait-gradient analysis
- [`trait_gradient_weights()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_gradient_weights.md)
  : Trait-gradient analysis with the two choices of weights
- [`trait_gradient_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_gradient_test.md)
  : Null models of the trait-gradient analysis
- [`trait_gradient_phylo()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_gradient_phylo.md)
  : Phylogenetic models of beta and alpha, with their sampling error
- [`trait_gradient_bayes()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_gradient_bayes.md)
  : Bayesian phylogenetic model of the trait gradient, with latent beta
- [`pp_check(`*`<mc_trait_gradient_bayes>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/pp_check.mc_trait_gradient_bayes.md)
  : Posterior predictive check of the trait-gradient model
- [`plot(`*`<mc_trait_gradient>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.mc_trait_gradient.md)
  [`plot(`*`<mc_trait_gradient_test>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.mc_trait_gradient.md)
  : Plot a trait-gradient analysis
- [`community_index()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/community_index.md)
  : Trait indices of communities against null models
- [`trait_flex()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_flex.md)
  : Intraspecific variability and species turnover in community trait
  means
- [`plot(`*`<trait_flex>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.trait_flex.md)
  : Plot the decomposition of community trait means
- [`nested_variance()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/nested_variance.md)
  : Variance components of traits across nested levels
- [`plot(`*`<nested_variance>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.nested_variance.md)
  : Plot the shares of variance across nested levels
- [`null_intervals()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/null_intervals.md)
  : Null intervals of the tests of each site
- [`plot(`*`<tstats>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.tstats.md)
  [`plot(`*`<community_index>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.tstats.md)
  : Plot the null-model tests of each site
- [`trait_densities()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_densities.md)
  : Trait probability densities of populations and communities
- [`plot_population_traits()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_population_traits.md)
  : Plot the trait distributions of populations within communities
- [`nn_distances()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`mnnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`sdnnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`cvnnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`min_nnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`max_nnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`mnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`sdnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`cvnd()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`mst_length()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`mst_ratio()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`trait_range()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  [`trait_kurtosis()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/neighbour_metrics.md)
  : Classic metrics of trait spacing and spread
- [`subsample_individuals()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/subsample_individuals.md)
  : Subsamples of individuals
- [`trait_rarefaction()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/trait_rarefaction.md)
  : Rarefaction of a statistic over sampling effort
- [`plot(`*`<trait_rarefaction>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot.trait_rarefaction.md)
  : Plot a rarefaction of a statistic

## Results

Tables, summaries and plots of results.

- [`as.data.frame(`*`<mc_node_test>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mc_node_test>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)
  [`plot(`*`<mc_node_test>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)
  [`as.data.frame(`*`<mc_pcc>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mc_pcc>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)

  [`summary(`*`<mc_pcps>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/result-methods.md)

## Example data

- [`daphniids`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/daphniids.md)
  : Daphniids of the northeastern United States

## Rule-based assembly

Community assembly without population dynamics.

- [`assemble_community()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/assemble_community.md)
  [`print(`*`<mc_assembly>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/assemble_community.md)
  : Assemble a local community from a regional pool by rules
- [`plot_assembly()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/plot_assembly.md)
  : Plot a community assembled by rules in trait space

## Dynamic null model

Colonisation and local extinction along the tree (DAMOCLES).

- [`simulate_damocles()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/simulate_damocles.md)
  : Local presence along a tree: the dynamic null model of DAMOCLES
- [`damocles_loglik()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_loglik.md)
  [`damocles_fit()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_loglik.md)
  : Likelihood of local presences under the DAMOCLES model
- [`damocles_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_test.md)
  : Phylogenetic community structure against the dynamic null model of
  DAMOCLES
- [`damocles_lrt()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_lrt.md)
  : Likelihood-ratio test between nested DAMOCLES fits
- [`confint(`*`<mc_damocles_fit>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/confint.mc_damocles_fit.md)
  : Profile-likelihood intervals of DAMOCLES parameters
- [`clade_regimes()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/clade_regimes.md)
  : Regimes of the edges of a tree from a list of clades
- [`damocles_samples()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_samples.md)
  [`summary(`*`<mc_damocles_samples>`*`)`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_samples.md)
  : DAMOCLES fits over many configurations of regimes or covariates
- [`damocles_partition_test()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/damocles_partition_test.md)
  : Test a partition of the tree against random partitions
- [`random_regimes()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/random_regimes.md)
  : Random partitions of a tree like a given one
- [`dr_rates()`](https://provetelab.org/comdynamite/reference/dr_rates.md)
  : Tip diversification rates (DR) of Jetz et al. (2012)
